Examples: - `realm=test-realm` - `realm=test-realm AND ip_address=10.0.0.0` - `realm=test-realm AND ip_version=IPV6` - `realm=test-realm AND resource_id="*my-range*"` - `realm=test-realm AND attribute_text=test` - `ip_address=10.0.0.0 AND attribute:(key1=value1) AND attribute:(key2=value2)` - `attribute_text=test AND parent_range=projects/123/locations/global/discoveredRanges/test-parent-range` - `management_type=CNR`
